nodes.summary: For every list $xs$ of elements of a linearly ordered type, heap sort returns a list that is sorted in nondecreasing order and is a permutation of $xs$.
nodes.title: Correctness of heap sort

nodes.summary: For every list $xs$ of elements of a linearly ordered type, the output of heap sort on $xs$ and $xs$ itself are equal as multisets: every value occurs in both lists the same number of times.
nodes.title: Heap sort preserves multiplicities

nodes.summary: For every list $xs$ of elements of a linearly ordered type, heap sort returns a permutation of $xs$.
nodes.title: Heap sort permutes its input

nodes.summary: For every list $xs$ of elements of a linearly ordered type, heap sort returns a list sorted in nondecreasing order.
nodes.title: Heap sort output is sorted

nodes.summary: For a list $xs$ of elements of a linearly ordered type, heap sort inserts the entries of $xs$ one at a time, from first to last, into the empty binary min-heap, and then extracts the minimum of the heap as many times as the heap has entries, each time continuing with the remaining heap. The output is the list of the extracted minima in the order in which they were extracted.
nodes.title: Heap sort

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
